final_message: In bes-index, F004/DC-004 is addressed by writing the list-side test coverage viewpoints for the two uncreated individual BES (`bes-derived-content-requested` and `bes-cycle-arrived`/`bes-routine-due`), but the QE coverage check is still outstanding. For F002, confirmed and recorded that `bes-task-ready-selected` already references back, so the bidirectional reference is set. F001 (catalog fix, out of scope) and F003 (data-model mapping not possible within declared references) remain as tracked issues. Updated the ticket's work table and response section. Re-grade was not run; it is left to the orchestrator.
handoff: F001: `dct-business-model-bes.yaml` still describes `bes-index` as covering ten process domains (comment on lines 12-13 and the `overview`); it should be aligned to the 14 domains the PO approved. The catalog is outside this task's targets, so it was not edited. A separate register item for BA is needed.

F003 / DC-003: the fact-data mapping to the data model or schema was not done because no data model is in the declared references. It stays as the PJR-AK5V reservation, for ARC to check before handing over to the event processing and messaging design.

F004 / DC-004: the executor did not perform the QE coverage check on behalf of QE. QE needs to review the coverage check section of bes-index before the confirmation step (T-KATA-WAVE-1 140) and record the result in that review result.

F002: the current text of `bes-task-ready-selected` already references bes-index and the matching row, so the bidirectional reference is set (checked 2026-11-17). Only the record in the detailing section of bes-index was added.

Ticket work table row No 4 (re-grade) is left open because the orchestrator runs `grade run --target deliverable`. DC-003 and DC-004 are expected to remain unmet until the reservations and the QE check are resolved.
